transcript:
WEBVTT

1
00:00:01.000 --> 00:00:02.800
Alex Vendor: Thanks for making time, Jordan. How does invoice matching work today?

2
00:00:03.100 --> 00:00:06.000
Jordan Placeholder: I lead the freight audit team, so this is my world.

3
00:00:07.200 --> 00:00:14.500
Jordan Placeholder: Honestly it's all by hand. Every Friday two of us match carrier invoices against

4
00:00:14.500 --> 00:00:19.800
Jordan Placeholder: purchase orders in Excel, and at Brightwater that eats most of the day.

5
00:00:20.100 --> 00:00:23.000
Alex Vendor: And once it's matched, who picks it up?

6
00:00:23.400 --> 00:00:31.200
Jordan Placeholder: We email the sheet to accounts payable, they re-key it into NetSuite, and things get lost between the two teams.

7
00:00:31.500 --> 00:00:38.000
Jordan Placeholder: And some carriers send invoices six weeks late, so we're closing the month with gaps. Last quarter that was about $240,000 we couldn't accrue.

8
00:00:38.400 --> 00:00:40.000
Alex Vendor: That's helpful, thank you.
